comment: Rdc2 is a flavin-dependent halogenase involved in the biosynthesis of the fungal metabolite radicicol. Halogenation of dihydroresorcylide in the radicicol pathway. Rdc2 additionally halogenases dihydroresorcylide and specific hydroxyquinolines. Non Substrate: 2/4/8-Hydroxyquinoline isomers, quinoline

reactions.description: Rdc2 catalyzes the regioselective chlorination of a late-stage intermediate (monocillin II to pochonin D) during radicicol biosynthesis
Rdc2 can also halogenate hydroxyisoquinoline to produce chlorinated hydroxyisoquinolines
Iterate chlorination of dihydroresorcylide. Reaction SMARTS shows all derivates trough 'any bond'.
Chlorination occurs sequentially at C13 and then C15.
Iterate bromination of dihydroresorcylide. Reaction SMARTS shows all derivates trough 'any bond'.
Bromination occurs sequentially at C13 and then C15.
